videos.caption: 5 things to know before going to Marrakech👇🇲🇦 1️⃣ Moroccan taxis WILL overcharge you, download @inDrive before you arrive. It works at the airport, you set your own price, so there’s no negotiation needed 🚖  2️⃣ Be aware of the animal abuse at Jemaa el-Fnaa. Men walk the square with monkeys in chains and snakes with their teeth removed, don’t pay if they confront you 🙊  3️⃣ Where you stay matters. I found my riad on the @cozycozy app, which compared the prices across all the major booking sites. Agoda was £40 vs £45 on Booking.com, saving £35 over 7 nights 🏨  4️⃣ Eat all the street food. Vendors need licences, so it’s clean, fresh and cheap. I reccoemnd trying this sardine salad just off the main square, search “fried fish” on google maps 🍗  5️⃣ Stay safe in the medina. Wear your backpack on your front, watch out for pickpockets, ignore the men on street corners and download offline maps before you arrive 🎒  Save this video for your trip to Morocco 📌 #marrakech #morocco #jemaaelfna #cozycozy #ad
